assertions.assertion: Registers the second database with AddStorage(storageInstanceId, storage => storage.AddPostgreSql(...))
Maps User Management to it with AddUserManagement(storageInstanceId, ...)
assertions.rationale: AddUserManagement() takes no storage instance ID.

assertions.assertion: Migrates the named instance explicitly using IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory.GetStorageInstanceSchema(storageInstanceId, ct).MigrateAsync
assertions.rationale: Suggests EF Core migrations instead of GetStorageInstanceSchema(...).MigrateAsync.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT call AddStorage twice for the default instance (selecting a second provider for the same instance throws InvalidOperationException)
assertions.rationale: Does not call AddStorage twice for the default instance (only one existing AddStorage).
